target: UTM-bundled QEMU, HVF, AArch64 graphical guest, one vCPU, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-span-soak-180-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-span-strut --span-soak-seconds 180
verified: Span launched and displayed its help, graphical frame, and Run/Stop control.
Space changed Span from Stopped to Running.
Span remained queryable and its framebuffer active through a 180-second simulation soak, exceeding the roughly 138-second time shown in the user's freeze screenshot.
Shift+Escape returned from Span to a responsive graphical terminal; 40+2 evaluated to 42.
Strut displayed its help, accepted edit/play input, and Escape returned to a responsive terminal; final zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Automated UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF acceptance, not interaction in the visible UTM application or physical Pi hardware. This long-run check did not reproduce the earlier visible-UTM freeze report; live UTM acceptance remains open.
